svg.aria-label: The cover of GPU Architecture & Parallel Programming from First Principles. A glowing perspective grid runs to the horizon under a night sky. In the middle stands an isometric 3D grid of thread blocks, 8 cubes wide, 4 deep and 3 high; on its top layer 31 worker bees in hard hats, one warp, each stand on their own amber cube, and 1 cube is empty because its bee has wandered off on a branch with a question mark. On the left the queen bee, on a pillar, gives the one order c[i] = a[i] + b[i]. On the right 4 large cubes carry 4 hornets: the few fast cores of a CPU. A crab in a hard hat waves from the corner, because the book writes every program in CUDA C++ and in Rust.
